title: After shrinking the open the support of the constructed module is proper over the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-existence with K as in Lemma labelled lemma-compute-what-it-should-be and W as in Lemma labelled lemma-finitely-presented, the lemma asserts that for F = H^0(K)|_W, after possibly shrinking W, the support of F is proper over A (statement lines 8244-8251). For each n the proof sets I_n = Ker(A -> A_n) and notes that the pair (A, I_n) is henselian by More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-limit-henselian (proof lines 8253-8258). Letting Z be the support of F, which is closed because F is finitely presented, part (3) of Lemma labelled lemma-finitely-presented identifies Z x_Spec(A) Spec(A_n) with the support of F_n, hence proper over Spec(A/I_n) (proof lines 8260-8264). More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-split-off-proper-part-henselian then splits Z = Z_1 coproduct Z_2 with Z_1 proper over A and Z_1 x Spec(A/I_n) equal to that support, so Z_2 misses X_0, and replacing W by W minus Z_2 gives the claim (proof lines 8266-8271). Using the henselian pair to split off the proper part of the support is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
